title: `SubViewport` + `own_world_3d` enabled with `Camera3D` + `OmniLight3D`/`SpotLight3D` crashes the engine in Forward+
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible since c1253d3aad0ae0195c1ffc8583dc20fba5ef9c8c (from bisecting) - Crash in a1eaac8171a53e5a74cd511bc144bd28afc4c7ff - Not reproducible in 4.6.1 ### System information Godot v4.7.dev (a1eaac8) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 04 Mar 2026 18:25:08 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 590.48.01) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 14.97 GiB memory, Can be reproducible in Windows 11 RTX 4050 595.71 ### Issue description Add nodes like this : Then, enable `own_world_3d` in `SubViewport` and the engine crashes. ### Output ``` ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: FAILED at: fence_wait (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:2965) ERROR: Printing last known breadcrumbs in reverse order (last executed first). at: print_lost_device_info (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:6933) ERROR: Searching last breadcrumb. We've sent up to ID: 5 ERROR: Last breadcrumb ID found: 0 ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UNKNOWN_BREADCRUMB(0) ================================================================ handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 ``` But adding a `WorldEnvironment` node inside the viewport node with the `sky` property set does not crash the engine. ### Steps to reproduce Set the driver to `Forward+` and do the steps above ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Not needed
